name: Detect Evil and Good
summary: Senses Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead within 30 feet of you.

stats.effect:
For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of yourself. You also sense whether the *{ref:spell/hallow}* spell is active there and, if so, where.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
